# Contract: Record Action

<!-- Generated by Spec-Kit /speckit.plan | Session: a0048076-0ae1-42e8-b25c-9d53f1b17c55 | Date: 2026-01-26 -->

## Overview

Records a single agent invocation with full metadata.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `-Action` | string | Yes | - | Must be "Record" |
| `-AgentName` | string | Yes | - | Agent identifier (e.g., "backend-developer") |
| `-Model` | string | Yes | - | AI model: "opus", "sonnet", "haiku" (FR-001) |
| `-TaskId` | string | Yes | - | Task ID from agent response |
| `-Status` | string | Yes | - | "completed", "failed", "timeout" |
| `-TokensUsed` | int | No | 0 | Total tokens consumed |
| `-DurationMs` | int | No | 0 | Execution duration in milliseconds |
| `-Description` | string | No | "" | Task description |
| `-Category` | string | No | "other" | Task category (FR-007) |
| `-IsParallel` | bool | No | false | Was `&` operator used (FR-009) |
| `-ParallelGroupId` | string | No | - | Group ID for parallel invocations |
| `-GroupSize` | int | No | 1 | Expected concurrent count |

## Behavior

1. Load existing `agent-metrics.json`
2. Validate required parameters
3. Create invocation object with all fields including:
   - `phase`: from session
   - `invocationStartTime`: calculated from timestamp - duration
   - `invocationEndTime`: current timestamp
4. Add invocation to array
5. Update aggregates:
   - Per-agent statistics
   - Per-model statistics (FR-001)
   - Per-category statistics (FR-007)
   - Parallel group metrics (FR-009)
   - Session totals
6. Save updated file
7. Output confirmation

## Preconditions

- Session must be initialized (agent-metrics.json exists)

## Postconditions

- Invocation recorded in metrics file
- All aggregates updated correctly

## Example

```powershell
.\agent-metrics.ps1 -Action Record `
    -AgentName "backend-developer" `
    -Model "sonnet" `
    -TaskId "a620108" `
    -Status "completed" `
    -TokensUsed 45000 `
    -DurationMs 120000 `
    -Category "implementation" `
    -IsParallel $true `
    -ParallelGroupId "pg-20260126-100300" `
    -GroupSize 3
```

## Output

```text
Recorded: backend-developer [sonnet] (completed) - 45,000 tokens, 2m 0s
```

## Error Handling

| Error | Behavior |
|-------|----------|
| No metrics file | Exit with "Run -Action Init first" |
| Invalid model | Log warning, use configured default for agent |
| Invalid status | PowerShell ValidateSet rejects |
| Negative tokens | Use 0 with warning |
